name: Aniyome to Sono Haha ~Isourou Shiteita Ani no Ie ni Yome no Haha ga Korogarikonde Kita Kekka www~
original_name: 兄嫁とその母 ～居候していた兄の家に嫁の母が転がり込んできた結果www～
source:
The protagonist began to live with his brother and sister-in-law due to entering university.

However, he was moved by his brother'wife Eriko, who used to be a model.

One day, her mother Marino fought with her husband, left the house and came to live with them.

That event created ripples, like a stone being thrown into quiet water, and started to affect their relationship...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=874113]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公因为上大学，开始和哥哥及嫂子一起生活。

然而，他被曾经当过模特的嫂子绘里子深深吸引。

某天，绘里子的母亲真理乃与丈夫吵架后离家，搬来和他们同住。

这件事像一颗石子投入平静的水面，激起涟漪，开始影响他们之间的关系……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=874113]Getchu[/url]]
